note: The classes of defect that have actually happened to a driver in this repository (DRY-COVERAGE-PLAN.md item 12.C.2). Every seed names one. `finding` says where it was first found; a class with no finding is one the wire and units layers of docs/robot-support.md section 2 name as the ways a driver is wrong. `undetectable` is the control: a change no dry suite can see, which must survive.

unit-scale.what: a value in the wrong unit or scaled by the wrong factor: radians read as degrees, milli- read as whole units, a rate in the wrong period

sign.what: an axis or direction with the wrong sign: a joint that turns the other way, a north that is an east

byte-order.what: a field read or written at the wrong offset, width or endianness

crc-seed.what: a checksum, signature or counter computed with the wrong seed, polynomial or coverage

mode-enum.what: the wrong value of a mode or state enumeration: a velocity mode that is not velocity, a state read as its neighbour

latch-across-sessions.what: a stop latch that outlives its session, or one that a new session cannot clear, or two sessions that cannot coexist

hold-as-limp.what: a hold or zero mask that means 'go limp' on the wire instead of 'stay where you are'

ack-then-fault.what: a command acknowledged and then faulted on, because the driver checks the acknowledgement and not the state afterwards

zero-vs-absent.what: a value of zero that means 'no such quantity' being sent, or read, as a real zero

request-reply-wedge.what: a request/reply protocol read on the caller's schedule, so one dropped or extra reply leaves the stream one frame out for the rest of the session

stop-on-deactivate.what: the stop sent only on a path that a crash or a kill does not run

half-applied-refusal.what: a command refused part-way that has already stored or sent part of itself

read-before-first-read.what: the first read returning an initial zero that is taken for a measurement, so a joint is held at zero before it has been read

neighbour-index.what: a sensor, joint or channel wired to its neighbour's index

sticky-error.what: a fault that, once seen, is read as fine for the rest of the session, or one that is never cleared

range-widening.what: a limit taken from the controller's own report where the vendor's table is narrower, so travel is allowed into a region the firmware faults in

jitter-as-stall.what: one late sample read as a stalled stream, or a stall read as fine

refusal-missing.what: a command the controller would take badly that the driver used to refuse and now sends

stop-path.what: a stop that does less than it says: a step missing from it, a step in the wrong order, a release that leaves the latch set

stale-history.what: a stream read oldest-first, or an old sample re-served as new, so the driver acts on the past

vendor-code-class.what: a vendor state or alarm code reported as less than it is: a stop read as degraded, a fault that sets a flag §27 does not read, an unlisted code read as healthy, or a command taken while the controller is ignoring it

undetectable.what: a defect in behaviour no dry suite can exercise (real time, real hardware, a network the counterpart never drops): the metric's control, which must survive
